caption: The drawing consists of two main objects rendered in fine, light pencil lines on a beige or off-white background. The larger object, dominating the top portion of the image, is a geometrically folded shape resembling a piece of paper or cloth folded into angular sections, with clear, straight edges and overlapping triangular flaps; some faint shading indicates depth at certain folds. Near the bottom right of the drawing is a smaller object that appears to be a circular band, possibly a collar, with a fabric piece tied in a knot at the front, the knot and loose ends draping downward. The drawing is minimalistic, uses thin, delicate lines, and has no use of color except for the natural color of the paper and pencil marks. There is some handwritten text within the large folded shape, indicating a possible signature and date.
title: Neckerchief
